title: Ultimate Optimization
description: Ultimate Optimization is a Forge 1.20.1 modpack that can boost FPS up to 2x using modern optimization mods. Perfect both as a standalone optimization pack and as a base for larger modpacks.
body:
# Ultimate Optimization

Ultimate Optimization is a Forge 1.20.1 optimization modpack designed to deliver the best possible performance while keeping Minecraft smooth, stable, and fully compatible with large modpacks.

This pack combines modern optimization technologies to improve rendering, memory usage, chunk loading, entity processing, and overall game performance. It significantly reduces lag, micro-stuttering, and long loading times while increasing FPS by up to 2x depending on your hardware and installed mods.

Unlike many “FPS packs” that only focus on graphics settings, Ultimate Optimization improves both client and server performance. The modpack was carefully built to stay lightweight, stable, and compatible with most Forge modpacks.

## Features

• Up to 2x higher FPS
• Faster game startup and world loading
• Reduced RAM usage
• Smoother chunk loading
• Better overall stability
• Reduced lag and micro-freezes
• Shader support
• Improved client and server optimization
• Compatible with large RPG, magic, and Create-based modpacks

## Perfect For

• Large Forge modpacks
• RPG and adventure modpacks
• Magic and tech modpacks
• Create-based modpacks
• Players with low-end PCs
• Players who want maximum performance without changing the Minecraft feel

Ultimate Optimization works great both as a standalone optimization pack and as a base for creating larger custom modpacks.
